sloka: राक्षसाधम रामस्य भार्यममिततेजसः ।इक्ष्वाकुकुलनाथस्य स्नुषां दशरथस्य च ।अवाच्यं वदतो जिह्वा कथं न पतिता तव ।। ५.५८.७० ।।।।
transliteration: rākṣasādhama rāmasya bhāryamamitatejasaḥ ।ikṣvākukulanāthasya snuṣāṁ daśarathasya ca ।avācyaṁ vadato jihvā kathaṁ na patitā tava ।। 5.58.70 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O lowly demon I am the wife of valiant Rama and daughterinlaw of Dasaratha, the king of Ikshvaku race. How is it your tongue that spoke unspeakable words has not fallen down?
